subject: Marketplace procurement: billing handoff & legal evidence for vendor activation
messages:
From: Alex Smith <alex.smith@cloudretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: acct-pay@cloudretail.com, procurement@cloudretail.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: marketplace billing / vendor evidence for Redwood listing

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. We are ready to finish the vendor activation for Redwood on CloudRetail Marketplace, but our finance and legal teams need two things before we can issue the transactable PO:

1) A completed payor-mapping worksheet so our billing team knows who to invoice (CloudRetail central or regional reseller).
2) Evidence of business registration + a W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) and the vendor questionnaire filled out for our security team.

I've attached the PO template we plan to use and flagged the payment terms we prefer (Net30). Can your team confirm whether Redwood can accept marketplace remittance (we sometimes collect via marketplace billing instead of direct invoice)?

We are hoping to have this closed by EOD Wednesday so the listing can go live the following week.

Appreciate it — Alex

Attachments: cr_po_template.docx (attachment)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Smith <alex.smith@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: marketplace billing / vendor evidence for Redwood listing

Hi Alex — thanks, and great to meet earlier.

Short answers up-front: we can accept marketplace billing for AWS and GCP. For Azure there are two routes (transactable vs. marketplace reseller) — Vanessa can confirm which variant you prefer.

I've attached our W-9 and the vendor questionnaire (filled). Kim, can you confirm the legal evidence checklist is sufficient for CloudRetail? Vanessa, I’m looping you for payor routing and whether we need an alternate invoice address for regional reseller flows.

Next steps I propose:
- Vanessa: confirm payor mapping route and fill the payor-mapping-form.xlsx (deadline Mon 8/17).
- Kim: quick review of evidence packet and call out any missing items for CloudRetail’s security team (deadline Tue 8/18 EOD).
- Alex: confirm if CloudRetail will accept Net30 via marketplace settlement or needs Redwood to invoice directly.

Summary of attachments I just uploaded: redwood_w9.pdf, marketplace_vendor_questionnaire.pdf, payor-mapping-form.xlsx, evidence_packet.zip

Thanks — Jasmine

Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: marketplace billing / vendor evidence for Redwood listing

Alex / team — quick update on payor mapping:

- For AWS & GCP: CloudRetail can be set as the marketplace payor (CloudRetail settles to Redwood via the marketplace clearinghouse). We support that.
- For Azure: if you want transactable listing, we require either (a) reseller mapping (CloudRetail as reseller) or (b) a direct invoice to CloudRetail with their marketplace surcharge applied. Azure’s settlement windows are 45 days in some regions; please confirm which billing cadence you require.

I filled the payor-mapping-form.xlsx and put tentative bill-to values: CloudRetail (Headquartered) / regional account as needed. Ben — can you confirm tax implications on our side (EIN mapping) and whether we need to add a separate invoice remit address for CloudRetail EU?

Also attaching a short note about how marketplace settlement appears on our side so your finance team knows expected GL codes and line items.

Vanessa
Partner Activation Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Smith <alex.smith@cloudretail.com>, Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: marketplace billing / vendor evidence for Redwood listing

Adding finance confirmation — short version:

- We can accept Net30 via marketplace settlement for AWS and GCP. For Azure, we need the exact payor mapping to ensure correct VAT treatment and invoice remit. If CloudRetail will be the payor, we will need a PO that references the marketplace transaction ID or marketplace invoice number.
- Attached: payor-mapping-form_filled.xlsx (final) and a stubbed GL mapping note.

Kim / Legal: the W-9 looks correct for US entity. If CloudRetail requires additional signed attestation for marketplace compliance, please flag — otherwise we can proceed to DocuSign the standard vendor onboarding T&Cs.

Alex: please send the PO referencing CR-7821 or you can use the DocuSign link below for the Marketplace Agreement signature. Once signed and we receive the PO id (or marketplace settlement id), we’ll schedule the activation window.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/example-docu-sign
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/CR-7821

Ben Carter
Head of FinOps, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Next steps: marketplace billing / vendor evidence for Redwood listing

Thanks team — that all looks good. Procurement will issue PO CR-2026-0818-RED and reference the HubSpot record. We are comfortable with Net30 marketplace settlement for AWS and GCP; for Azure we will route via reseller (CloudRetail will be payor).

Procurement is attaching the signed PO and we’ll complete the DocuSign agreement now. Expect the signed package and PO PDF in the next hour.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — once a few items finalize on your side (DocuSign + marketplace invoice mapping) we can flip the switch for the listing.

— Alex
